name: Wyoming Summer 2021

venue.name: [College Heights Baptist Church](https://www.collegeheightscasper.org/)
venue.details: Parking lots are south of the building. The competition is in the large sanctuary/gym on the east side of the building.

information: # All persons entering the venue will be required to have proof of a negative COVID-19 test from up to 96 hours prior to the competition or proof of vaccination to enter the venue. If you have symptoms of COVID-19, please do not attend this competition. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), the WCA [Competition Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), and our [Risk Management Plan for this competition](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wMjYn8D3sdeKuGOvRS9HOcracspftxw6/view?usp=sharing). Please read through the [Judging](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WyomingSummer2021#15768-judging) and [Competing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WyomingSummer2021#15771-competing) tabs before registering. Competitors are advised to bring their own pens. Most competitors will be expected to judge.
